name: @gears-frontx/template-design-guardrails
description: Apply this to any FrontX project that builds screens: it supplies the design rules screens are generated from and the design review they are checked against. It adds no runtime screen and owns no application code; it installs a short human-readable entry point, the @gears-frontx/design-verify workspace package (the runtime design-defect checker and its headless render runner, the static source check, the composed-markup axe suite, and the jsx-a11y lint fragment, with their dependencies), plus an AI-extension bundle with two skills: frontx-design, which themes, builds, reviews and verifies screens by the design rules (a short map over its references, machine-readable rules and handoff templates); and frontx-design-proposal, which, before a new page is built, when the person asks to see it first or accepts the one short offer made when its look is neither seen nor described, draws it in the person's language on one local proposal page in the app's own look, records the answer in .frontx/proposals/ and builds the chosen design. The render check requires the app to stamp the applied theme's registry id as data-theme-id on <html>; the skill's references/verify.md ("Theme id stamp") gives the code for a project whose shell does not.
